title: Universal Bounds for Self-Normalized Kullback-Leibler Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work studies an entropy-based estimator of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence constructed from normalized importance weights. We prove a universal finite-sample bound showing that its expectation can exceed the target-proposal KL divergence by at most $\log 2$ for any sample size. We then characterize the KL divergence between the distribution induced by importance-weighted resampling and the proposal, showing that it is upper bounded by both the expectation of the entropy-based estimator and the target-proposal KL divergence. Importantly, these bounds require neither bounded importance weights nor finite higher moments. We apply these results to test-time alignment of generative models via Soft Best-of-$N$ sampling, an importance-sampling-based scaling technique proposed by Verdun et al. (2025), and to relative entropy coding, obtaining finite-sample policy-divergence certificates and moment-free bounds on coding cost.

translated_title: 自归一化Kullback-Leibler估计的通用界
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了一种基于熵的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度估计器，该估计器由归一化的重要性权重构造而成。我们证明了一个通用的有限样本界，表明对于任意样本量，该估计器的期望超过目标-提议分布间KL散度的幅度至多为 $\log 2$。随后，我们刻画了由重要性加权重采样所诱导的分布与提议分布之间的KL散度，证明其上界同时由基于熵的估计器的期望和目标-提议分布间的KL散度约束。重要的是，这些界既不要求重要性权重有界，也不要求高阶矩有限。我们将这些结果应用于通过Soft Best-of-$N$采样实现生成模型的测试时对齐（这是Verdun等人（2025）提出的一种基于重要性采样的扩展技术），以及应用于相对熵编码，得到了有限样本策略散度证书和无需矩条件的编码成本界。
tldr: 本文证明了基于归一化重要性权重的KL散度估计器存在通用有限样本界——其期望超过目标-提议KL散度至多 $\log 2$，且无需重要性权重有界或高阶矩有限，并将该结果应用于生成模型的Soft Best-of-$N$测试时对齐与相对熵编码。
en_tdlr: This paper proves universal finite-sample bounds for a self-normalized KL divergence estimator—showing its expectation exceeds the target-proposal KL by at most log 2 without requiring bounded importance weights or finite higher moments—and applies these results to Soft Best-of-$N$ test-time alignment of generative models and relative entropy coding.
